import_predictions.note: Spec A import with gate-1 fixes M1/m9; ambiguity stops with questions

analyse_predictions.note: Report contacts, positions, surface/register agreement, RNA pose difference; repeat agreement only for exactly two structures (engine) or two runs (designated structures, gate-1 M4)

region_contacts.note: number of structures with at least one contact in a declared position range; no new statistic

evaluate_against_reference.note: DockQ, class, fnat, iRMSD, LRMSD; four-axis geometry withheld

compare_prediction_sets.note: matched before/after on designated structures; correspondence and evaluability changes never pooled

region_comparison.note: shared and run-specific contacts in a declared range from Report's contact records; mirrors the capability status

explain_evidence.note: read from execution records; nothing recomputed

show_distinct_proposals.wraps: rnplens group (0.4), shown as distinct proposals only
show_distinct_proposals.note: members per proposal in the grouping's display order; never ordered by size; no representative, ranking or selection

diagnose.reason: Diagnose statements and bands await requalification against the corrected (CP-V2) evidence; not part of this assistant version

geometry_decomposition.reason: Evaluate's four-axis geometry route (protein-internal, RNA-internal, RNA placement RMSD) has a known residue-correspondence defect; the corrected implementation is not yet qualified

ranking.reason: RNPLens Rank was closed (2026-10-14); no candidate ranking or selection is offered

grouping.reason: grouping as selection is not offered: groups are shown only as distinct proposals (show_distinct_proposals), never ranked or used to select a structure

new_predictions.reason: RNPLens assesses existing predictions; it does not predict structures

mutation_advice.reason: no mutation or experiment is recommended

successor_of: rnplens-assistant-tool-registry-1 (frozen for gate 1; unchanged entries below)

followup.note: bounded result-aware follow-up (Function 4); EXPERIMENTAL until the frozen live suite (FOLLOWUP_SUITE_v1 Part 2) has run
